item.text: The repository has only the stub and no CSV dependency or reusable parser. I’m keeping the implementation scoped to this two-column format: split physical rows, parse the first comma outside a quoted region, unescape standard doubled quotes, convert the amount with `Number`, and centralize finite-number validation here. No general-purpose CSV machinery is warranted.

item.text:
Implemented `summarizeSales(csv)` in [src/summarize.js](C:\Users\bash\AppData\Local\Temp\offcut-bench-work-NMefVT\repo\src\summarize.js).

It now:

- Sums amounts by region.
- Handles quoted regions containing commas and escaped quotes.
- Ignores blank rows.
- Throws `TypeError` for non-finite amounts.
- Safely supports keys such as `__proto__`.

Verified with Node smoke tests and `git diff --check`. No dependencies added.
